title: kate-core: make one tab the active tab
summary: activate shows the named view inside its pane. The tab list stays in the same order. A missing view returns false. The test goes in the existing workspace tests module. This waits for PKT-0025.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: fn activate(&mut self, view: ViewId) -> bool

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: workspace.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add activate on impl SplitTree. Add #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]. Set the leaf active index to the index of the view. Return true. A leaf that does not hold the view returns false. A Split node tries the first child, then the second, with ||. Use let Some(index) = ... else { return false }. Do not nest an if inside an if.  Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. Do not touch split_after, insert_tab, or remove_tab. The existing test split_after_moves_the_later_tab stays green. Do not rewrite its assertions. The test activate_shows_the_named_tab uses workspace, new_document, and add_view twice. The leaf active index starts at 1. activate of the first view returns true and the active index is 0. The tabs stay in the same order. activate of the second view returns true and the active index is 1. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Stay inside this one behavior. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::activate_shows_the_named_tab
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because activate does not exist. After the change two tabs can show the first view and then the second view again. The tab order stays first then second.
